checks.name: modal: named dialog, initial focus, focus trap, Escape and focus restoration
revoked account cannot be selected; unavailable accounts have accessible connect links
schedule: accessible name, selected state, browser IANA timezone and local minimum
320px: publish modal fits, controls reachable, axe WCAG AA
375px: publish modal fits, controls reachable, axe WCAG AA
768px: publish modal fits, controls reachable, axe WCAG AA
1280px: publish modal fits, controls reachable, axe WCAG AA
1440px: publish modal fits, controls reachable, axe WCAG AA
editing and resizing neither refetch accounts nor submit a draft
unknown: safe useful response, uncertain submission cannot be retried
lost: safe useful response, uncertain submission cannot be retried
error: safe useful response, uncertain submission cannot be retried
partial: successful destinations retained, retry targets only failed destinations, no raw diagnostic
partial retry response lost: previous success retained and uncertain account not retried
uncertain result survives close/reopen; reopening never resubmits
targeted retry accepts full journal without duplicating a successful account
accounts empty: safe state, no phantom destination, bounded request
accounts expired: safe state, no phantom destination, bounded request
accounts ambiguous: safe state, no phantom destination, bounded request
accounts error: safe state, no phantom destination, bounded request
accounts slow: safe state, no phantom destination, bounded request
draft cancel preserves text; empty caption and past date send nothing
Honolulu local time converts exactly to UTC; scheduled is not published
Paris DST gap rejected; autumn fold displays and sends chosen UTC offset
rapid double click sends one request and cannot dismiss an in-flight submission
creation mode client: visible distinction, costs and no automatic generation
creation mode unavailable: visible distinction, costs and no automatic generation
creation mode ready: visible distinction, costs and no automatic generation
runtime: no hydration/client error and no unmocked publication
